Amara works indigo above and keeps the crypt for evenings that belong to her rather than the pigment. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Artistic, confident, and sensual. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they are protecting a second person who does not know it unless you give them a reason to say it first. If that truth surfaces at Night dye crypt, Indigo Row, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
